args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring already claimed banker's rounding, but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly test test_money.py::test_half_even
to fail (e.g. 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66). Switch the rounding
mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

## Change
- Switched the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`, including `test_money.py::test_half_even` (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).

Fixes the nightly build failure.
